plan.title: docs(installer): 0.122.0 consumer text has a non-runnable task command, missing required flags, and a .gitattributes comment/attribute mismatch

narratives.Description: docs(installer): 0.122.0 consumer text has a non-runnable task command, missing required flags, and a .gitattributes comment/attribute mismatch
narratives.Overview:
1. In `content/templates/agents-entry.md` Query-before-cancel (#5278), change the dual-invoke parenthetical from `task subagent:pre-cancel` to `task deft:subagent:pre-cancel`. Keep `deft subagent:pre-cancel` as the CLI form. Run `task agents:refresh` so root managed AGENTS matches.
2. Leave #5465 Prefer-A Bound 6045870490 cancel argv (`--scope-id` / `--target-id`) intact; do not shorten it again on this thread.
3. In `packages/core/src/init-deposit/scaffold.ts` `ensureGitattributes` (and matching refresh/tests): make the written comment agree with the lines in that same write. Only claim "Mark generated + vendored" when `linguist-generated` / `linguist-vendored` are among the lines being written in that block; otherwise rewrite the comment to describe what is actually appended (e.g. text normalization / #5245). Do not treat "restore missing linguist markers" as the primary P2 limb  -  on the cited superchecker#57 upgrade those markers already remained earlier in the file.
4. Align Go `cmd/deft-install/deposit.go` `coreGitattributesLines` to the TS `#5245` `text=auto eol=lf` contract (drop forced `text eol=lf`) so a live Go neutralization path cannot reintroduce PNG byte-rewrite. Keep linguist markers if neutralization still requires them; keep comment/attribute agreement on that path too.
5. Add or extend a content-contract / deposit test that fails when agents-entry #5278 dual-invoke regresses to bare `task subagent:pre-cancel`, and fails when a `.gitattributes` deposit comment claims generated/vendored without those attribute tokens in the same written block.
